Jules (Marketing): Hey everyone — finalizing the launch playbook for next Wednesday's public release. Need a few things from eng/docs before I lock the schedule:
- Final changelog entries (one-liners we can paste into the blog)
- Permalinks to the user docs and upgrade notes
- Exact rollout timing + canary window (include TZ) so we can schedule social/webinar + press embargo
- Any benchmark numbers we can safely publish and the owner for questions
Can we freeze changelog by EOD tomorrow? Draft playbook here: https://docs.google.com/path/to/launch-playbook

Alex (Eng): We can freeze by EOD tomorrow. I'll drop the changelog snippet into the playbook and paste the final commit ids here. For timing, current plan is:
- Canary start: 2027-06-02 02:00 UTC (2 hours)
- Full rollout: 2027-06-02 04:30 UTC
We'll keep the canary at 5% traffic, step to 25% after 30m if no errors. SLA notes: no API schema changes, just model/quantization updates.

Sanjay (Tech Evals): Benchmarks: safe to publish these summary numbers:
- p50 latency (1k tokens): 120ms on A100-dedicated
- cost improvement vs baseline: ~38% (optimized batching + KV cache)
I'll add a one-line explainer and link to the full benchmark notebook. Owner for questions: me (Sanjay).

Priya (Docs): Links I will add to the playbook in the next hour:
- User guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/docs/user/upgrade-path
- Changelog permalinks: https://docs.redwood.ai/docs/changelog#v2.4.0
- Migration notes (config diffs): https://docs.redwood.ai/docs/migration-v2.4
I will also add an FAQ blurb for the webinar.

Alex (Eng): Pasting changelog snippet below (one-liners). Please use these verbatim in the blog:```
- Improved KV cache eviction to reduce tail latency at long sequences
- Added quantized GPT-style runtime with 4-bit fallback for cost-sensitive workloads
- Fixed memory leak in batched attention routing when request queue grows
```
Commits: a1b2c3d..f6e7g8h

Jules (Marketing): Perfect. A few follow-ups: can we get the benchmark notebook link (not internal) so we can link to it publicly? Also, inbound lead routing — can eng confirm the webhook payload we'll get for trial signups so Sales can set up routing to trials@redwood.com and tag by model-variant? We also want UTM templates for social posts.

Sanjay (Tech Evals): Notebook (public trimmed version): https://benchmarks.redwood.ai/v2-4-summary. It includes methodology and dataset notes. Ready for public link.

Alex (Eng): Webhook payload: we'll POST to /webhooks/signup with body:
```json
{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "org": "ACME Corp",
  "trial_plan": "dedicated-30d",
  "model_variant": "gptq-4bit",
  "utm_source": "twitter",
  "utm_campaign": "v2_4_launch"
}
```
Sales routing: set to trials@redwood.com. We'll include a `tags` array in the next patch if you want explicit tags for routing.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout created by @alex. Canary: 2027-06-02T02:00:00Z -> 2027-06-02T04:30:00Z. 5% -> 25% -> 100% steps.

Jules (Marketing): Awesome. I'll schedule the blog and social to go live at 2027-06-02 04:35 UTC right after full rollout. Webinar: let's do a live demo the same day at 18:00 UTC — I'll email presenters. Can someone confirm there's no embargo conflicts with any partner announcements?

Priya (Docs): No partner embargo on our side. If anything changes I'll flag in this thread.

Alex (Eng): No partner blocks from eng. :+1:

Jules (Marketing): Great — thanks all. I'll update playbook with these exact links/changelog/benchmarks and send the embargoed copy to press list tomorrow morning. Please ping here if anything moves. :rocket:
